Mepolizumab (USAN, rINN) Mépolizumab; Mepolizumabum; SB-240563. Immunoglobulin G1, anti-(human interleukin 5) (human-mouse monoclonal SB- 240563 γ1-chain), disulfide with human-mouse monoclonal SB- 240563 κ-chain, dimer. Меполизумаб CAS — 196078-29-2. Profile Mepolizumab is an anti-interleukin-5 monoclonal antibody. It is under investigation in the treatment of hypereosinophilic syn- drome (chronic eosinophilic leukaemia), as well as eosinophilic oesophagitis, and asthma. ◊ References. 1. Leckie MJ, et al.
